  • The moved host-wheel check retains Python 3.12 and TREAMS_RS_NUM_THREADS=1 (ci.yml:201–235).
  • Python versions, dependency matrices, Hypothesis budget, deselections, and smoke profiles remain unchanged.
  • The Intel wheel uses the original smoke script and Python matrix through YAML anchors, running on Intel hardware (native-wheels.yml:229–272). Release assembly depends on completion of the entire reusable workflow (release-candidate.yml:116–127).
  • Release candidates supply source_revision; both new Rust-cache setup steps explicitly require an empty value (native-wheels.yml:128–141). Release compilation therefore bypasses that cache.
  • The xdist hooks preserve the global Rayon-pool failure and unavailable-dependency reporting; regression tests exercise serial and parallel sessions (tests/conftest.py:357–418, tests/api/test_collection_policy.py).
